Introduction

OFF EQUALS is a South Korean virtual boy band under NAME X Entertainment. The band consists of three members: Hosoo, Norann, and Gorey. They debuted on August 26, 2025 with the digital single "READY OR NOT". The group uses motion capture technology to perform their band activities.
